title: Guardian Alliance
next_chapter_hook: The conditions of the Guardian Alliance have been presented, and the trump card that Chen Ji had never used was stirring with the faint glow of the last page of the Tianji Record...

text.content:
In the eerie light deep within the imperial mausoleum, Chen Ji slowly opened his eyes. The lingering karmic aura from his father still swirled around him, the words 'break the karmic anchor' turning like a key in his mind.
The Tianji Record Fragment automatically surfaced, its characters even clearer than before—but not a prophecy. Instead, it was a dynamic map. Three lights of different colors were converging from across the Three Realms.
Gold, representing the remnant lineage of the Ancient Heavenly Court.
Cyan, representing the ancient Shennong lineage.
Crimson, representing the Lord of the Netherworld Cycle.
'Master,' Mo Xiansheng's remnant spirit drifted from the first page, his voice uncharacteristically grave, 'the Guardian Alliance... has arrived.'

The mausoleum's stone door burst open, and three figures walked in side by side.
The leader was a white-haired elder, surrounded by faint golden threads of law, each thread inscribed with ancient contract characters—those were the first divine laws inscribed before the fall of the Ancient Heavenly Court. His aura was as deep and restrained as an abyss, yet it instinctively made Chen Ji feel dangerous.
'Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance, Thirty-Seventh Generation Administrator,' the elder slightly bowed, his voice calm and unhurried, 'I am Tianxuanzi, greetings to the Chosen One of Prophecy.'
Behind him, a woman in cyan robes held a medicine cauldron, her face hidden behind a thin veil, revealing only a pair of eyes as deep as an ancient well. The visitor from the Netherworld was shrouded in crimson mist, making even their silhouette unclear.

dialogue.content:
'Tianxuanzi... the Tianji Record has记载 about you.' Mo Xiansheng's voice rang in Chen Ji's Mental Sea, carrying a complex emotion. 'He is the sole surviving administrator from the fall of the Ancient Heavenly Court, having survived for three hundred and seventy thousand years. In terms of seniority, no one in the Three Realms can surpass him.'
Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged on the surface, but his heart sank slightly. A three hundred and seventy thousand-year-old monster, far older than even Ling Yuan.

text.content:
'Chen Ji,' Tianxuanzi straightened up, his gaze as unruffled as an ancient well, 'the Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance has been observing you for some time. As the one chosen by the Tianji Record, according to the ancient contract, we are obligated to guide you onto the righteous path.'
His tone was not threatening, yet carried an理所当然 arrogance, as if Chen Ji were merely a stray child needing correction.
'The so-called righteous path,' Chen Ji raised his head, a faint smile curling at the corner of his mouth, 'is to continue being a chess piece of the Heavenly Dao?'
At these words, the air within the mausoleum suddenly froze. The cyan-robed woman's hand paused slightly, and the existence within the crimson mist let out a low, cold hum.

dialogue.content:
Tianxuanzi shook his head, his expression even showing a trace of pity: 'You are mistaken, Chosen One of Prophecy. The Heavenly Dao is not as simple as you think. It is the foundation of the Three Realms, the maintainer of dimensional barriers. Without the Heavenly Dao, the Netherworld will devour the mortal world, the Ancient Demon Realm will tear through the Void, and your so-called 'freedom'—will only be a chaos where none survive.'
He stepped forward, golden threads gathering in his palm into a miniature Seal of Law.
'The purpose of the Alliance is to guard this balance. For thirty-seven thousand years, we have prevented seventeen dimensional invasions and quelled countless cycle disorders.' Tianxuanzi's voice was low and powerful, 'Do you think you are the first person who wanted to break the Heavenly Dao?'

text.content:
Chen Ji did not speak, just quietly looked at the other party.
Tianxuanzi continued: 'Before you, there were seventy-three Chosen Ones of Prophecy. Each of them was once like you, ambitious, wanting to change the world.' He paused, his tone almost cruel in its plainness, 'They are all dead now. Dead in the crevices of dimensional invasions, dead in the chaos they themselves triggered, dead in... the backlash of Heavenly Dao's will.'
From the depths of the mausoleum, it seemed a cold wind was howling past.
'You are the seventy-fourth,' Tianxuanzi looked at Chen Ji, 'and the Alliance's duty is to ensure you do not become the seventy-fourth failure.'

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly laughed.
That smile was very faint, but it made Mo Xiansheng cry out in alarm within the Mental Sea—because it was precisely the expression he always wore before each successful scheme.
'Elder Tianxuanzi,' Chen Ji's voice was calm as water, 'you say the Heavenly Dao is balance, is foundation, is the maintainer of dimensional barriers.'
He stretched out his hand, and the Tianji Record Fragment slowly rotated in his palm.
'Then I would like to ask—' his gaze直视 those ancient eyes, 'why does the Tianji Record show that beneath this so-called 'balance', the Three Realms must experience a great catastrophe every ten thousand years? Each catastrophe, living beings suffer, all things return to nothing. Is this what you call 'protection'?'

text.content:
The air completely solidified.
Tianxuanzi's expression fluctuated for the first time with subtle changes. The cyan-robed woman—the descendant of the ancient Shennong lineage—trembled slightly, her medicine cauldron in hand. The Netherworld Lord within the crimson mist let out a low moan.
'You...' Tianxuanzi's voice gained a sharper edge, 'what have you seen?'
Chen Ji did not answer, only gently flipped the Tianji Record Fragment. A blurry image emerged on the Fragment: countless figures wailing in darkness, their bodies being devoured by an intangible will, turning into nutrients to maintain the 'balance'.
That was the truth of the Heavenly Dao.
The great catastrophe was never a natural disaster.
It was a man-made disaster. It was the Heavenly Dao's will harvesting all beings' Heavenly Fate to maintain its own existence... a gluttonous feast.

dialogue.content:
'Enough.'
Tianxuanzi suddenly waved his hand, golden threads like a cage rushing toward Chen Ji. However, in the next moment—
The crimson mist surged violently, and the Netherworld Lord's figure blocked in front of Chen Ji.
'Tianxuanzi,' that low voice came from within the crimson mist, carrying impatience, 'whether what he said is true, you and I both know in our hearts.'
The cyan-robed woman also stepped forward, the medicine cauldron in her hand emitting a soft cyan light, protecting Chen Ji in the center. She did not speak, but her posture had already explained everything.
The Guardian Alliance, split for the first time.
Tianxuanzi's expression completely darkened: 'You...!'

choice.prompt: Signs of division appeared within the Alliance, with the three parties holding different attitudes. Chen Ji needs to make a critical choice: to use this crack to win allies, to divide and disintegrate the opposing camp, or to directly state his position?

choices.description: The Shennong lineage regards protecting all beings as its sacred duty, and her previous gesture indicates she is already wavering.
choices.visible_cost: Consume 3 points of Heavenly Fate from the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Gain initial trust from the Shennong lineage

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned to the cyan-robed woman, the images on the Tianji Record Fragment flowing and changing: 'Elder, Shennong tasted hundreds of herbs and martyred himself for the cause—for what? If he knew that his descendants' supposed guardian was actually an existence that treats all beings as worthless...' He did not finish, but the unspoken meaning was heavy enough.

choices.description: Tianxuanzi has the highest seniority but is also the most stubborn; if he can be isolated, the Alliance will completely split.
choices.visible_cost: Expose partial understanding of the Heavenly Dao
choices.visible_reward: Tianxuanzi's prestige is damaged, the Alliance exists in name only
choices.process_label: use record to expose Tian Shuzi's involvement

dialogue.content: Chen Ji looked at Tianxuanzi, his smile growing colder: 'Elder speaks beautifully of guarding balance. Then I would like to know—over these three hundred and seventy thousand years, how many Chosen Ones of Prophecy's Heavenly Fate have you personally harvested?' On the Tianji Record Fragment, a尘封的画面slowly浮现: seventy-three figures, walking toward destruction under Tianxuanzi's gaze.

choices.text: Confront the Heavenly Dao's Will directly
choices.description: Since the Guardian Alliance represents the Heavenly Dao's stance, let's lay our cards on the table and see how many trump cards they have.
choices.visible_reward: Gather intelligence on the Guardian Alliance's true strength
choices.risk_hint: Fall into a three-way encirclement attack
choices.process_label: resonate with heaven's eye, declare challenge

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the Imperial Mausoleum, stirring up dust. "Guardian Alliance?" His voice turned icy cold, "Nothing but Heavenly Dao's lapdogs. You want me to surrender—" The Tianji Record Fragment abruptly unfurled, a surge of overwhelming momentum erupting skyward, "Then come try."

text.content: The atmosphere within the Imperial Mausoleum froze solid. Tianxuanzi's expression was so dark it could drip water. He never expected this seemingly worthless Prophet would dare expose the truth. "Well done," Tianxuanzi's voice turned sinister. "It seems I underestimated you. Since that's the case—" He raised his hand, golden threads tightening abruptly. But the next moment, blood mist and the medicine cauldron both moved simultaneously. "Tianxuanzi," the voice of the Netherworld Lord carried like nine nether winds, "the Alliance's ancient pact—we both know it. Without a two-thirds majority vote, forcible measures cannot be used against the Prophet." Tianxuanzi's hand froze mid-air.

dialogue.content: "Are you betraying the Heavenly Dao?!" Tianxuanzi's voice sharply rose, the weight of hundreds of thousands of years pressing down like mountains. "Betray?" The woman in azure finally spoke, her voice cold and clear as spring water, "If the Divine Farmer Ancestor knew his descendants acted as wolves' accomplices, he would truly die with regret." She turned to Chen Ji, removing her veil. Beneath it was a face of breathtaking beauty, yet carrying the weariness of ages. "Chen Ji," she met his gaze directly, "the Divine Farmer bloodline can support you. But you must answer one question—after breaking the Heavenly Dao, what kind of order do you intend to establish?"

choice.prompt: The azure-clad woman's question struck at the core: what would be the new order after breaking the Heavenly Dao? This was the ultimate question Chen Ji had to face.

choices.description: Promise to establish a new order of equality for all beings, displaying the bearing of a benevolent ruler.
choices.visible_reward: Gain full support from the Divine Farmer bloodline
choices.risk_hint: If unable to fulfill, all credibility will be lost
choices.process_label: show ideal order blueprint with record

dialogue.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then spoke slowly: "I don't want to be any savior. But if I can ensure living beings are no longer harvested as nutrients, if I can give everyone the opportunity to master their own fate—" He lifted his head, his gaze clear and resolute, "This is the order I desire."

choices.description: Any promise made now is empty talk; the true answer must be proven through action.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji smiled faintly: "If you want a promise, elder, I cannot give one. The future of all living beings under heaven is not something I alone can decide." He paused, "But there is one thing I can guarantee—I will never be a second Heavenly Dao."

text.content: The azure-clad woman gazed at Chen Ji for a long while before finally nodding slightly. "Very well." She said only one word, yet in her hand appeared a azure token. "The Divine Farmer Seal is here. From this day forth, the Divine Farmer bloodline supports the Prophet in opposing the Heavenly Dao." The Netherworld Lord also let out a low laugh: "An interesting little one. The Netherworld bloodline... also refuses to remain the Heavenly Dao's puppet any longer." With two major powers defecting, Tianxuanzi's expression turned completely ashen.

dialogue.content: "Good! Good! Good!" Tianxuanzi repeated three times, his laughter growing increasingly sinister. "Do you truly believe that without us, order can still be maintained?" He abruptly raised his hand, and above the Imperial Mausoleum, a golden pillar of light descended. Within that pillar, a massive eye slowly opened, gazing down indifferently at everyone present. The Heavenly Dao's Eye. "Prophet," the celestial voice resounded through the Imperial Mausoleum, carrying irresistible authority, "This is your final chance. Surrender, or—destruction."

text.content: Chen Ji felt that pressure enough to shatter ordinary cultivators' souls, yet a smile actually curved his lips. "My father once said," he spoke slowly, his voice not loud but clearly reaching everyone's ears, "the Heavenly Dao is not invincible; the key lies in breaking its causal anchor." He lifted his head, staring directly at that lofty eye. "And I happen to know where your causal anchor is." The Heavenly Dao's Eye contracted sharply. The temperature in the Imperial Mausoleum instantly froze.

dialogue.content: "What did you say?" For the first time, a tremor appeared in the Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice. Chen Ji took out an ancient token from his chest—this was the final legacy his father Chen Tianming left him before dying. On the token was engraved a faint rune, and that rune matched the shape of the pupil at the center of the Heavenly Dao's Eye... perfectly. "This token is the causal seed left by your first caretaker." Chen Ji's voice was terrifyingly calm. "Three hundred seventy thousand years ago, he discovered your secret, yet you devoured him. But karmic retribution is inevitable—his obsession never faded."

text.content: The Heavenly Dao's Eye's radiance suddenly intensified, the entire Imperial Mausoleum trembling. But just as it was about to strike— Tianxuanzi's hand suddenly seized its pillar of light. "Enough!" Tianxuanzi's voice was hoarse, and there was actually a flicker of fear in his eyes. "Master, you cannot act here! The dimensional barrier—" "What is there to fear?!" The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice was like thunder, "It's merely another harvest—" "Enough!!" Tianxuanzi sharply interrupted, "You promised me! As long as I maintained the surface balance, you would never touch them again!"

choice.prompt: The dialogue between Tian Shuzi and the Eye of Heavenly Dao exposed a shocking secret. The Tianji Record Fragment grew slightly warm, heralding the arrival of the moment of choice—seize the opportunity to create chaos, or use this as leverage?

choices.description: Spread this dialogue, completely destroying Heavenly Dao's image in the eyes of the world.
choices.visible_reward: Shake Heavenly Dao's Foundation in the Three Realms
choices.risk_hint: Bring Down Heavenly Dao's Frenzied Revenge

text.content: The Tianji Record Fragment suddenly unfurled, countless characters pouring out like flowing water, inscribing every word of the dialogue between Tian Shuzi and the Eye of Heavenly Dao. At this moment, Chen Ji felt the Tianji Record's temperature rise sharply—it too was anticipating.

choices.description: Use this as leverage to demand Tian Shuzi reveal the precise location of Heavenly Dao's causal anchor.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji chuckled lightly: "Tian Shuzi elder, it seems you and Heavenly Dao have quite some grievances and entanglements." He waved the Tianji Record. "Would you like me to help spread this dialogue? Let all the Three Realms see what kind of character the executive of the Guardian Alliance really is."

text.content:
Tian Shuzi's face turned as pale as paper. He never imagined that his tens of thousands of years of scheming would be seized upon by a mere youth at this moment.

"You...!"

Yet the Eye of Heavenly Dao had no attention to spare for him. That enormous eye stared fixedly at the token in Chen Ji's hand, the indifferent majesty in its gaze being replaced by a primal rage.

"The Seed of Causality..." its voice rumbled like thunder, "So Chen Tianming that traitor concealed such a trump card!"

Chen Ji smiled faintly, tucking the token into his chest: "Trump card? This is merely an appetizer."

"Chen Ji!" the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice suddenly rang out, "Do you think a single Seed of Causality allows you to contend with me? Ridiculous!"

Its light surged, and the dimensional barriers began to show tiny cracks. Beyond the Imperial Mausoleum, in the void, countless dark auras stirred restlessly.

"I give you ten days," the Eye of Heavenly Dao's voice descended like judgment, "Within ten days, surrender the Seed of Causality, submit to me. Otherwise—"

Its gaze swept over everyone present.

"I will make this Three Realms... buried with you."

As the words fell, the eye slowly closed, the golden pillar of light vanished without a trace. Only the solidified air remained, and the sound of the countdown beginning to tick.

Ten days.

The countdown to the final decisive battle officially began.

Silence descended upon the Imperial Mausoleum like death itself.

Tian Shuzi's form swayed precariously, his former arrogance completely vanished. The other two members of the Guardian Alliance—the woman in blue robes and the Lord of the Netherworld—wore grave expressions, clearly also shaken by the Eye of Heavenly Dao's threat.

"Master..." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke within Chen Ji's Mental Sea, "The Tianji Record indicates this is true. Heavenly Dao's will would truly resort to triggering a dimensional invasion to preserve its own existence."

Chen Ji stood in place, gazing down at the Seed of Causality in his palm. The token emitted a faint, eerie glow, as if responding to something.

"I know." he said softly, "Which is why..."

He raised his head, looking toward Tian Shuzi, his gaze carrying a strange light.

"Tian Shuzi elder, I need to speak with you privately."

Tian Shuzi's pupils contracted sharply.
